changes: Continuous glass shell subdivided into a 12-row pane grid with per-face teal tint variation
Narrower stepped mint lip, fuller corner collars and separate turquoise corner facets
Warmer golden cork/cord palette and more rounded cork edges
Leaf and paired cord loops moved around the neck; enlarged leaf hangs below the loops
Unreal refraction displacement scaled by 0.045 to avoid reading distant scene color through the small bottle
remaining: Exact pane coloration and irregular source block placement
Rim block silhouette and neck opacity
World lighting is much cooler and darker under the awning
physical_optics_limit: Blender transmission retains IOR 1.46/1.33. Unreal refraction input is 1 + (IOR - 1) * 0.045, an explicit screen-space approximation; this is not optical equivalence.

color_correction.finding: Corrected missing sRGB decode measured in the previous PNG16 atlas import. Geometry and material factors preserved.
